QuestInfo.name: [Arteria] Where's the Empress?
QuestInfo.1: Just as you reach the top deck of the ship, you stop hearing the Empress's voice. It's as if she has lost all her strength. Find her before time runs out.
QuestInfo.2: Finally, you come to a large door on the Arteria's top deck.
QuestInfo.0: You've reached the top deck of the High Flora ship, but where is the Empress?
